# truenas_iscsi_initiator (Data Source)

Looks up exactly one existing `iscsi.initiator` object by `id` or `query_filters`. Secrets are not exposed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Identifier of the object to read.
- `query_filters` (String) Middleware query filters as JSON, e.g. `jsonencode([["path", "=", "/mnt/tank/x"]])`. Must match exactly one object.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Optional comment describing the authorized initiator group.
- `initiators` (List of String) Array of iSCSI Qualified Names (IQNs) or IP addresses of authorized initiators.
